visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black glasses wearing a striped shirt stands in front of a white Sharp refrigerator in a modern kitchen. He looks hungry, holding his stomach while a large yellow text overlay covers the center of the frame. (2) He opens the refrigerator door and reaches inside to grab a clear plastic cup filled with fried chicken and yellow tartar sauce. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the wood-grain cabinets behind him. (3) The man approaches a Panasonic microwave oven, holding the food container. Suddenly, another man dressed in a white t-shirt with a 'Japanese' sign on his chest and a black bucket hat appears to block him, pointing sternly toward the label on the food. (4) A extreme close-up of the plastic container shows the 7-Eleven logo and Japanese text indicating 'Chicken Nanban'. The label is detailed with price and calorie information. (5) A fast-paced montage follows where the first man repeatedly attempts to put the food in the microwave, while the Japanese-coded character physically stops him with exaggerated, comedic expressions of disapproval. White cloud-like 'variety show' graphics surround them. (6) The conflict resolves as the first man opens the container without heating it. He uses chopsticks to lift a piece of chicken covered in sauce toward the camera. He looks pleasantly surprised. (7) Both characters celebrate the taste; the first man looks ecstatic with his eyes wide and mouth open in joy, while the second character gives a thumbs-up. The final scene shows the man sitting on the floor with a hair dryer, humorously celebrating his discovery.

(2) A sharp 'thud' and refrigerator hum are heard as the door opens, followed by a plastic rustling sound of the food cup. (3) A dramatic 'orchestral hit' or 'suspense chord' marks the sudden appearance of the Japanese-coded character. (4) A rapid sequence of comedic 'pop' and 'boing' sound effects sync perfectly with the visual montage of the character stopping the microwave attempt. (5) High-energy J-pop vocals kick in as the man finally tastes the chicken, with a shimmering 'sparkle' SFX highlighting his positive reaction. (6) The audio concludes with a triumphant crescendo of the upbeat BGM and a final 'ding' sound effect.
